scripts.text: What brings you here? Ho, you are not here to harm Wild Roses, are you?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？喔，你不是來傷害野貓玫瑰的吧？

scripts.text: This place is the village of Deserted people.
scripts.translation: 這裡是被遺棄之人的村莊。

scripts.text: Homeland of those who walk in the shadows and lay low.
scripts.translation: 也是那些行走於暗影、低調潛伏之人的故鄉。

scripts.text: ....And yet, our peace is being disturbed by those barking dogs.
scripts.translation: ...然而，那些亂吠的傢伙卻打擾了我們的安寧。

scripts.text: Would you be so kind and punish those Kobold Archers?
scripts.translation: 可以請你教訓一下那些狗頭弓箭手嗎？

scripts.text: They have their own territory south of here, but they're still trying to invade ours.
scripts.translation: 他們在南邊有自己的地盤，卻還想侵佔我們的領地。

scripts.text: How Impudent. I tried to talk to them in a peaceful way, or even fight them off, but it was of no use.
scripts.translation: 真是厚顏無恥。我試過和平交涉，也試著把他們趕走，但都沒用。

scripts.text: So what I'm asking you is... to drive them out of our territory by using all means necessary..
scripts.translation: 所以我想請你...不擇手段地把他們趕出我們的領地。

scripts.text: If you manage to do that, I will give you something precious which I really adore.
scripts.translation: 如果你辦得到，我會把一件我非常珍愛的寶物送給你。

scripts.text: Hmph, yeah, it was kinda funny huh.
Anybody who comes here....they all come to harm the Wild Roses..
scripts.translation: 來這裡的那些人...全都是來傷害野貓玫瑰的...

scripts.text: Of course take care of those Kobold Archers Meow!
scripts.translation: 當然是去對付那些狗頭弓箭手，喵！

scripts.text: Hmm Hmm I told you to never mind that.
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯，我不是說了別在意那個嗎？

scripts.text: Exactly 1,000 times no more, no less.
Give them 1,000 warnings and they will back off.
scripts.translation: 警告他們1,000次，他們就會退縮。

scripts.text: What do you mean by 1,000 warnings...?
Hu~Do I have to spell it out for you?
scripts.translation: 唉～非要我把話說得這麼明白嗎？

scripts.text: As she says that, Myu slides her neck mocking like she's slitting her throat.
scripts.translation: 繆一邊說，一邊在脖子上劃了一下，做出割喉的動作。

scripts.text: ..But they won't give up if we dont really teach them a lesson.
scripts.translation: ...不過不給他們一點真正的教訓，他們是不會放棄的。

scripts.text: Well If you think it's too much for you, so be it.
scripts.translation: 如果你覺得這太難，那就算了。

scripts.text: But you have to keep one thing in mind and it is
scripts.translation: 不過有一件事你一定要記住，那就是

scripts.text: obiously, NEVER EVER do any harm to Wild Roses.
scripts.translation: 絕對、絕對不許傷害野貓玫瑰。

scripts.text: If you do, it's all over for you.
scripts.translation: 要是你敢這麼做，就別想活著離開。

scripts.text: Did you think I didn't know what you have done?
scripts.translation: 你以為我不知道你做了什麼嗎？

scripts.text: How..just how could you kill those precious children..?
scripts.translation: 怎麼...你怎麼能殺害那些可愛的孩子...？

scripts.text: And you were saying that you are on our side?!
scripts.translation: 你還說自己是站在我們這邊的？！
我們之間的交易到此結束！！！

scripts.text: Now, those Kobolds should have learned a lesson, haven't they?
scripts.translation: 現在那些狗頭人應該得到教訓了吧？

scripts.text: This is the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats'.
scripts.translation: 這是我們“勇敢貓咪”的徽章。

scripts.text: This is soooo valuable, so don't lose it.
scripts.translation: 這可是非常珍貴的東西，千萬別弄丟了。

scripts.text: That Pow is really a valuable thing!
scripts.translation: 那個波真是件珍貴的東西！

scripts.text: Now, just take it and leave. Wild Roses feel uncomfortable with an adventurer around them.
scripts.translation: 拿上它離開吧。冒險者待在身邊會讓野貓玫瑰不自在。

scripts.text: (What a weirdo.. Anyways..what's with that meow meow sound?)
scripts.translation: （真奇怪...話說回來，這喵喵聲是怎麼回事？）

scripts.text: Of course! Don't worry about that~
This place is the village of Deserted people.
scripts.translation: 這裡是被遺棄之人的村莊。

scripts.text: Homeland of those who walk in the shadows and lay low.
scripts.translation: 也是那些行走於暗影、低調潛伏之人的故鄉。

scripts.text: Oh, Aren't you the Adventurer who took the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats'.
scripts.translation: 哦，你不是那個拿走我們“勇敢貓咪”徽章的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text: Oh yeah, right, even after all the threats we gave the Kobolds..
scripts.translation: 對了，就算我們威脅了狗頭人那麼多次...

scripts.text: our situation hasn't changed at all. Would you mind helping us once more?
scripts.translation: 情況還是一點都沒變。能再幫我們一次嗎？

scripts.text: Myu slides her neck mocking like she's slitting her throat.
scripts.translation: 繆做出抹脖子的動作，像是在嘲諷對方。

scripts.text: Her mouth looks like it's saying.
Well, looks like a bait has spoiled....
It's ok. That's how it is. Meow.
Never ever touch the Wild Roses, Only hunt down the Kobold Archers.
scripts.translation: 絕對不許碰野貓玫瑰，只能去討伐狗頭弓箭手。
陽光真暖和...讓我想睡覺...

scripts.text: Please talk to our teacher if you are here to make a dyes.
scripts.translation: 想染色的話，請和我們的老師交談。

scripts.text: And talk to my friend next to me if it is about the delivery.
scripts.translation: 如果是來送東西的，請和我旁邊的朋友說。

scripts.text: And just what are you doing?
I can dye small things really pretty..
scripts.translation: 我能把小東西染得很漂亮...

scripts.text: Bring me a Cute Ribbon if you want to dye it.
scripts.translation: 想染色的話，就帶一條可愛緞帶來。

scripts.text: It'd be a good chance for me to practice one,
scripts.translation: 這正好能讓我練習一下，

scripts.text: and you won't have to pay a single zeny.
Oh yeah, but I will at least need the required^4d4dffdyestuffs^000000.
scripts.translation: 對了，不過至少得帶上所需的^4d4dff染料^000000。

scripts.text: I will put all my efforts into it.
I want to challenge my skills!!
scripts.translation: 我想挑戰一下自己的技術！！

scripts.text: (I have a Cute Ribbon...what should I do..?)
scripts.translation: （我有一條可愛緞帶...該怎麼辦呢...？）

scripts.text: Oh, So you want to dye your Cute Ribbon, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 哦，你想給可愛緞帶染色，對吧？

scripts.text: What colour is your Cute Ribbon?
scripts.translation: 你的可愛緞帶是什麼顏色的？

scripts.text: Which one is the one you want to be dyed?
Ok Ok, Yellow Cute Ribbon, huh?
scripts.translation: 好，好，是黃色可愛緞帶啊？

scripts.text: What color do you want it to be dyed?
scripts.translation: 你想把它染成什麼顏色？

scripts.text: - Elgo starts to dissolve dyes and chemicals in water, then he begins to dye the Cute Ribbon. -
scripts.translation: - 埃爾戈將染料和藥劑溶解在水中，開始給可愛髮圈染色。 -

scripts.text: Did this color came out nicely?
If you want to dye it white, bring me ^4d4dff1 White Dyestuffs^000000.

scripts.translation: 啊，這次我不太確定。下次再來吧。

scripts.text: Ok. It's fine. I will see you later~ Bye Bye~!
Hmm, I will bring you one next time.
I need to get back to work...
This Orc Lady is absorbed in something.
scripts.translation: 這位獸人女士正專心做著什麼。

scripts.text: I don't know what she's making...but she wouldn't notice me even I walk up on her.
scripts.translation: 我不知道她在做什麼...不過就算我走到她面前，她大概也不會注意到。

scripts.text: Should I talk to her?...Uh..Do we even understand eachother?
scripts.translation: 要和她說話嗎...呃...我們能聽懂彼此的話嗎？

scripts.text: THe Orc Lady suddenly turns around looking surprised.
scripts.translation: 獸人女士突然轉過身來，顯得很驚訝。

scripts.text: A Maneater Blossom fell on the ground out of her hands.
scripts.translation: 一朵食人花花朵從她手中掉到了地上。

scripts.text: Pick up the flowers for Orc Lady.

scripts.translation: 帶武器的冒險者要幫獸人？

scripts.text: Surprisingly the Orc Lady introduced herself to me.
scripts.translation: 沒想到獸人女士竟然向我介紹了自己。

scripts.text: Ask her what she was up to.
Would you make one for me?
Trade with you.. the one I just made.
scripts.translation: 和你交換...我剛做好的這個。

scripts.text: (^4d4dff Silk Ribbon and 1,000 Maneater Blossoms^000000, huh..)
scripts.translation: （^4d4dff絲綢緞帶和1,000朵食人花花朵^000000，嗯...）

scripts.text: Got it. I will go and bring back the materials.
scripts.translation: 知道了。我去把材料帶回來。

scripts.text: I nodded goodbye to her with a smile on my face saying nothing.
scripts.translation: 我什麼也沒說，只是微笑著向她點頭道別。

scripts.text: She nodded back to be as if she understood that was my good bye.
scripts.translation: 她也向我點頭，彷彿明白我是在道別。

scripts.text: Let's run away while she's still in shock.
scripts.translation: 趁她還沒回過神，趕緊溜吧。
